def mkhdr(tmpl, kinds, dyn=None, q=None, ttl=None, z=None, breakK=None):
    h=bytearray(tmpl)
    for i,c in enumerate(kinds):
        if c=='D': h[i]= (dyn[i] if dyn and i in dyn else 0x11+ (i%20))
        if c=='Z': h[i]= (z[i] if z and i in z else 0xee)
    if q is not None: h[kinds.index('Q')]=q
    if ttl is not None: h[kinds.index('T')]=ttl
    if breakK is not None:
        kp=[i for i,c in enumerate(kinds) if c=='K']
        h[kp[breakK%len(kp)]]^=0xff
    return bytes(h).hex()
